data.description:
## Symptom
check-recipe-engines.sh wildcard engine detection case only checks binary presence, never version. Engines ts-morph (min 17.0.0), isort (min 5.0.0), and synvert (min 1.0.0) pass preflight with any installed version. An old ts-morph@16 or isort@4 silently passes preflight then fails during recipe execution.

## Root Cause
The rope engine has a dedicated case with _version_gte comparison. The wildcard case has no version comparison.

## Expected Behavior
OUTDATED_ENGINE emitted when non-rope engine is below min_engine_version in the registry.

## Actual Behavior
Outdated non-rope engines pass preflight (no OUTDATED_ENGINE emitted), only rope is version-checked.

## Fix
Add per-engine version checking for at least ts-morph (node) and isort (python3 -m isort --version).
data.title: check-recipe-engines.sh: version checking only implemented for rope engine
